description: This PHP file defines a controller class for managing the 'category' module in the OpenCart admin interface. It includes methods for displaying the module settings page and saving configuration changes, utilizing OpenCart's core MVC components.

classes.name: Opencart\Admin\Controller\Extension\Opencart\Module\Category
classes.description: A controller class responsible for rendering the category module configuration page and handling its save operations within the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the display of the category module configuration page, setting up the page data, including breadcrumbs and view components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the saving of configuration settings for the category module, including permission checks and returning the success or error status as JSON.
